hints.title: Recursive Tree Pruning
hints.text: Traverse nested structures depth-first, pruning nodes that fail validation or become empty after child removal.

hints.title: Bottom-Up Structural Collapse
hints.text: Distinguish arrays, objects, and primitive values. Retain containers only if at least one child remains valid.

hints.title: Deep Filter Blueprint
hints.text: If primitive, return fn(data) ? data : undefined. If array or object, recurse on children. Return container if non-empty, otherwise undefined.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total nodes in JSON structure
complexity.notes: Visits every key and primitive exactly once, using call stack proportional to nesting depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Shallow filtering leaves empty containers at higher levels when all descendants are removed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates pruned container clones while avoiding in-place mutation of the input.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recursive post-order traversal collapsing empty objects and arrays to undefined.
